title: OneRooms
description: Explore abnormal tectonic activities as a detective
body:
In this mod you'll be playing as a detective. You was assigned to invistigate abnormal tectonic activities but eventually found something unfathomable - giant illegal residential complex "OneRooms".

There you will encounter OneRoomer, Histor and more interesting entities.

OneRoomer - friendly near his shop, becomes more aggressive the deaper you explore and the more you disrupting the order of OneRooms.

Histor - friendly until you hit him, then...

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Swarz - very dangerous

</details>



<details>

Hiking - try to find him

</details>



<details>

Resident - self explanatory

</details>

Most interesting mechanics include:
- Procedural generation
- 100+ room layouts
- 10+ variants of behavior for OneRoomer
- Evidence collector
- Trading with OneRoomer (use odish near shop)
- Echolocation ability for OneRoomer
- 5 dimensions
- Cool weapon
- Works in multiplayer (use setplayers)

Geckolib IS REQUIRED

![spotted](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da2d81cd860d79ad38dd78973aea2ccb0649dc97.png)

P.S. for best expirience play vanila + OneRooms with just optifine (Sodium may cause bugs)
